verdict.rationale: Highnote's docs mention that it handles 'daily reconciliation, settlement' internally (highnote-docs-23) and that reconciliation runs on the 'same core ledger as issuing' (highnote-docs-44), with a unified ledger posting transactions in real time (highnote-docs-19, highnote-docs-3). However, there is no documented settlement-file export, dedicated reconciliation/report API, or schema covering interchange, fees, and network adjustments that a finance stack could consume programmatically — reconciliation appears to be an internal Highnote-managed process rather than a machine-readable artifact exposed to subscribers. Missing for 10: explicit settlement file format/API, interchange/fee/network-adjustment breakdown fields, and evidence of automated export to external finance systems.
